Yes, I said. Now I understand. The question which you would have me consider is, not
only how a State, but how a luxurious State is created. And possibly there is no harm
in this, for in such a State we shall be more likely to see how justice and injustice originate.

of which I was at first speaking, such as houses and clothes and shoes. The arts of
the painter and the embroiderer will have to be set in motion, and gold and ivory and
all sorts of materials must be procured.
